definition: to wash clothes and other washable household things
sentence: We do the laundry on Sunday.

definition: to put your coat on a hook or hanger
sentence: Hang up your coat by the door.

definition: to carry waste from inside to an outside bin
sentence: Please take out the rubbish.

definition: to put plates and other things ready for a meal
sentence: Can you set the table?

definition: to remove dishes and other things after a meal
sentence: We clear the table after dinner.

definition: to make a place clean and tidy
sentence: Clean up after the party.

definition: to wash yourself while sitting in a bath
sentence: I have a bath before bed.

definition: to sleep for a short time, usually during the day
sentence: The baby takes a nap after lunch.

definition: to begin sleeping
sentence: Close your eyes and go to sleep.

definition: to remain awake until a late time
sentence: I stay up late on Friday.

definition: to rest for a period of time
sentence: You look tired; get some rest.

definition: to remove used bed sheets and put on clean ones
sentence: We change the sheets on Saturday.

definition: to move your home and belongings to another home
sentence: They move house next week.

definition: to sleep later than usual in the morning
sentence: I sleep in on Sunday.

definition: to lock a building or place before leaving
sentence: Please lock up before you leave.

definition: to allow someone to enter
sentence: Open the door and let her in.

definition: to spend a period learning with a teacher
sentence: We have a lesson at ten.

definition: to write short pieces of information while listening or reading
sentence: Take notes while the teacher speaks.

definition: to say something because you want information
sentence: Raise your hand to ask a question.

definition: to give completed school work to a teacher
sentence: Hand in homework before the lesson.

definition: to do or say something incorrectly
sentence: I make a mistake in the sum.

definition: to try as hard as you can
sentence: Do your best in the race.

definition: to listen to or watch something carefully
sentence: Pay attention to the teacher.

definition: to say written words so that others can hear
sentence: Please read aloud to the class.

definition: to learn something so you can remember it exactly
sentence: We learn the short poem by heart.

definition: to get a successful result in a test
sentence: She works hard to pass a test.

definition: to get a result below the required level in a test
sentence: He is sad because he fails a test.

definition: to do a task with other people
sentence: We work together to build the model.

definition: to look at your completed work for mistakes
sentence: Check your work before you finish.

definition: to give something to each person in a group
sentence: The teacher hands out the papers.

definition: to walk for pleasure or gentle exercise
sentence: We go for a walk after dinner.

definition: to stay outdoors in a tent for enjoyment
sentence: We go camping by the lake.
additionalExamples: Camping is fun in good weather.

definition: to play a game using playing cards
sentence: They play cards after lunch.

definition: to make a kite fly in the wind
sentence: The children fly a kite in the park.

definition: to describe a series of events to someone
sentence: Grandma tells a story before bed.

definition: to do something one after another
sentence: The children take turns on the swing.

definition: to enjoy yourself
sentence: We have fun at the party.

definition: to visit interesting places as a tourist
sentence: We go sightseeing in the city.

definition: to take a long walk in the countryside
sentence: They go hiking in the hills.

definition: to swim for pleasure
sentence: We go for a swim in the pool.

definition: to listen to a radio programme
sentence: He listens to the radio while cooking.

definition: to watch a live or recorded performance
sentence: We watch a show at the theatre.

definition: to become a member of a group with a shared interest
sentence: He joins a football club.
